info.name: Campus Shoes - Distributor Return & Transfer
info.description: Distributor and retailer endpoints on /distributor-return/* and /distributor-transfer/*: (1) a distributor scans a batch of pair codes (the invoice for each pair is derived from the pair itself, so a batch can span multiple invoices and multiple retailers in one request) to reverse retailers' already-earned points on returned pairs, plus their retailer network and return history/detail (DISTRIBUTOR/SUB_DISTRIBUTOR role); (2) a retailer views their own return history and order-level detail across all distributors (RETAILER role); and (3) a distributor transfers a whole approved invoice's stock to another distributor, creating a PENDING_APPROVAL request (DISTRIBUTOR/SUB_DISTRIBUTOR role). All gated by JwtAuthGuard + RolesGuard.

variable.description: Either the pair_uid or the pair_qr value scanned off the physical pair

item.name: Distributor Return
item.description: Distributor scans a batch of pair codes to return redeemed pairs — the invoice for each pair is derived from the pair itself, so one request can span multiple invoices and multiple retailers at once. Each pair is validated independently (not found / not redeemed / already returned / invoice not approved / not owned by this distributor) and failures don't block the rest of the batch — the response splits results into `processed`/`failed` (or `items`/`failed` for validate) per pair.

request.description: Preview only — no mutation. `pairCodes` is a 1-50 item array of pair_uid/pair_qr values, deduped, each matched independently. Response: `{ items: [...matched pairs w/ retailer + estimatedRefundPoints], failed: [...per-pair failures], invoiceGroups: [...resolved pairs grouped by invoice, each w/ retailer + estimatedTotalRefund], summary: {total, valid, invalid} }`. Per-pair error codes: DRT_001 invoice not found (or not owned by this distributor), DRT_002 pair QR not found, DRT_003 pair not redeemed, DRT_004 already returned, DRT_005 retailer not found, DRT_006 invoice not approved, DRT_007 invoice expired. Every failure's `data` carries { reasonCode, reasonLabel, pair: {pairUid, pairQr}, product: {sku, name} }, plus { previousReturn: {returnId, returnedAt, minutesAgo} } on DRT_004.

Runs the same per-pair validation as /validate, then commits one return record per invoice group: debits each retailer's points (clamped to their balance, tracked independently per retailer within the batch), writes a point_histories refund row, updates each invoice's earned_points/scanned_pairs/scan_status, and creates a distributor_returns row (+ one distributor_return_details row per pair, unique on pair_id so the same physical pair can never be returned twice). Response: `{ processed: [...one entry per invoice group w/ returnNo, invoiceNumber, retailerId, pairsReturned, pointsRefunded, retailerRemainingPoints], failed: [...per-pair failures, same shape as /validate] }` — a batch spanning multiple retailers' invoices still returns 200 with partial success.

Retailers mapped to this distributor via user_mappings. Each item carries `totalArticles` — the count of that retailer's REDEEMED pairs (on invoices whose master_id matches this distributor's code) that haven't been claimed by an existing return yet, i.e. what's actually returnable right now. Response: { items: [{id, name, code, mobile, city, state, totalArticles}], pagination }.
Same shape as 'Return history', scoped to one retailer's returns only (set {{retailerId}} from 'My retailers'). Response: { items, totalArticles, pagination }.

Full detail for one return (set {{returnId}} from any history/retailer-returns list entry's `id`). Response: { id, returnNo, totalArticles, totalPointsRefunded, estimatedValue, remarks, createdAt, invoice, retailer: {id, name, code, mobile, city, state}, products: [...one per returned pair, {pairUid, pointsRefunded, productName, productCode, sizeCode, price}] }. `estimatedValue` is the sum of each returned pair's product MRP. DRT_008 if the return doesn't exist or wasn't processed by this distributor.

query.description: Matches the return number or the source invoice number

request.description: This distributor's own past returns across all retailers, newest first. Response: { items, totalArticles, pagination: { totalItems, totalPages, currentPage, pageSize } }. Each item's `retailer` now also carries `code`/`city`/`state`.

item.name: Retailer Return History
item.description: Retailer-facing view of their own returns — across ALL distributors, not just one. Gated to the RETAILER role. Uses {{retailerToken}} instead of {{distributorToken}} (overridden per-folder below).

query.description: Matches the return number or the source invoice number
Inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD — filters on when the return was processed
Inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD — filters on when the return was processed

request.description: This retailer's own past returns across all distributors, newest first. Response: { items, totalArticles, pagination }. Each item carries `estimatedValue`, `invoice` (incl. `invoiceDate`), `distributor: {id, name, mobile}`, and the returned `pairs`. `startDate`/`endDate` filter on return.created_at, both inclusive.

Full detail for one of this retailer's own returns (set {{returnId}} from 'My return history'). Response: { id, returnNo, totalArticles, totalPointsRefunded, estimatedValue, remarks, orderDate (from the original invoice), returnDate (when it was returned), invoice, retailer, distributor, returnedProducts: [...grouped by product+size, {productName, productCode, sizeCode, price, quantity, total}] } — unlike the distributor's 'Return detail', products here are grouped/summed by size rather than listed one row per physical pair. DRT_008 if the return doesn't exist or doesn't belong to this retailer.

item.name: Distributor Transfer
item.description: Distributor transfers a whole approved invoice's stock to another distributor. No per-pair scanning, no receiving distributor picked upfront — the request is created open (invoice number + optional remark only) and any other distributor can claim it via allocate. No approve/reject endpoints yet.

request.description: Preview only — no mutation, only the invoice number needed. Returns totalPairs, skuCount, billingEstimate. Errors: DTR_001 invoice not found, DTR_002 invoice not approved, DTR_006 a transfer for this invoice is already pending.

Runs the same validation as /validate, then creates the transfer request row with a generated request_no (TRF-CAMPUS-######), status PENDING_APPROVAL, and no receiving distributor yet (to_distributor_id null) — it sits open for any other distributor to claim via 'Allocate transfer request'. Only one pending request per invoice is allowed at a time.
PENDING_APPROVAL requests with no receiving distributor yet, excluding this distributor's own outgoing requests. Response: { items, pagination: { totalItems, totalPages, currentPage, pageSize } }.
The calling distributor claims an open request as its receiver, setting to_distributor_id. Errors: DTR_007 request not found, DTR_005 cannot allocate your own request, DTR_008 already allocated.
Set {{requestNo}} to the value returned by 'Create transfer request'. Viewable by either the sending or the receiving distributor; DTR_007 if neither.
This distributor's own sent transfer requests, newest first. Response: { items, pagination: { totalItems, totalPages, currentPage, pageSize } }.
